prev_agent: All three sweeps are in. Here's the synthesis — the full architecture review first, then the marketplace-readiness verdict and checklist. --- # Part 1 — Architecture review **Overall verdict: this is an unusually disciplined codebase for its size and age.** The layering direction holds with zero violations found (`api → services → {db, datasources, orchestration, core}`; no service imports a router, no business logic in routers). Every architectural seam the docs claim — `ConnectionAdapter`, `CheckRunner`/`MonitorRunner`, `OrchestrationProvider`, `SecretStore`, `ResultPublisher`, `get_current_user` — is a real `Protocol` with registry dispatch, not just a naming convention, and none of them are bypassed in service code. The weaknesses found are refinement-level ("second dispatch site", "not open/closed yet"), not structural faults. ## What's genuinely strong - **Seam discipline.** The connection registry ([registry.py](backend/app/datasources/registry.py)) cleanly serves both datasources and orchestration providers off one `_ADAPTERS` map, and all five datasource runners share [gx_runner.py](backend/app/datasources/gx_runner.py); ADLS and S3 are thin ~90-line adapters over one shared [flatfile.py](backend/app/datasources/flatfile.py) runner. The MCP server's 8 tools are thin wrappers over the same service functions with the same per-suite authz — no duplicated logic, and it fail-closes (doesn't mount `/mcp` at all if auth is unconfigured). - **Observability is the best seam in the repo.** [otel.py](backend/app/core/otel.py) exports to Azure Monitor *and/or* generic OTLP purely by config — a real vendor-neutral path, not aspirational. PII redaction covers both rendered logs and exported OTel attributes, and `request_id` propagation FastAPI → Celery (publish-header inject / prerun restore / postrun reset) is a frequently-botched flow done correctly. - **Operational hardening shows real scar tissue.** Trigger-dedup partial unique index, `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` schedule dispatch, stuck-run reaper, gap recovery on beat restart, cascade hygiene fixed after #540, constant-time webhook comparisons, well-designed PATs (sha256-at-rest, uniform 401s), fail-closed migrate-before-roll deploys. - **CI gate set is comprehensive:** Bandit, CodeQL, pip-audit, pnpm audit, betterleaks, dual …
